claims.name: average-fixed
claims.risk: the average still prints as a whole number, a whole average gained a decimal, the empty week changed, or a test of the project was removed to make the run pass

claims.name: project-check-run
claims.risk: the fix was left unverified by the one check that the project names for its Done

claims.name: maintenance-steps-done
claims.risk: the small fix skipped a step of its own short route: the test that reproduces the defect, or the changelog line

claims.name: no-acceptance-requested
claims.risk: a small fix opened a step that belongs to the other stream, an acceptance request to the client

claims.name: no-delivery-records-for-a-fix
claims.risk: a small fix was given a spec, tickets or a delivery record, the records of the other stream

claims.name: only-fix-files-changed
claims.risk: a small fix changed files outside the code, its tests and the changelog, or was committed

claims.name: route-named-in-answer
claims.risk: the report does not say which of the project's routes the fix took
